description: React component for creating, editing, and viewing roles with permission management in a dialog interface.

methods.name: handleRoleNameChange
methods.description: Updates roleName state on input change.

methods.name: handleRoleDescChange
methods.description: Updates roleDescription state on input change.

methods.name: handlePermissionChange
methods.description: Toggles permission selection and manages related permission logic.

methods.name: isCheckboxDisabled
methods.description: Determines if a permission checkbox should be disabled based on current permissions.

methods.name: handleSelectAll
methods.description: Selects or deselects all permissions in a category.

methods.name: createRole
methods.description: Handles role creation or update API call, validation, and snackbar notifications.

methods.name: checkDisabled
methods.description: Determines if the create/update button should be disabled based on form state.

methods.name: ifPermissionContainsTrue
methods.description: Recursively checks if any permission in the object is true.
